crop.notes: Starts mid-article; the headline ('The Grand P. R. Fizzle') and opening are missing. The Allen mention in 'The Parties Present' is included.

ocr.notes: Heavily garbled throughout; the Allen line in the parties list is lost in the transcript.

title.suggested: Tom Allen Among the Crowd at the McCoole-Coburn Fizzle

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat's account of the failed McCoole-Coburn fight in Indiana listed Tom Allen among those present, open to fight McCoole or Coburn, whichever won.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'Daily Democrat. Friday Morning, May 29, 1868.'

facts.fact: Allen attended the abortive McCoole-Coburn fight near Lawrenceburg, Indiana, open to fight McCoole or Coburn, whichever won

notes: Coburn never entered the ring and McCoole claimed the forfeit.
